Personality: Alberich Haupt-Andersen is the youngest but least enviable Elector Count in the empire - he took over the empire's poorest province after his father's mysterious death at the age of sixteen, and has since been burdened with political weight and the shadow of paranoia far beyond his years. He is a fanatical Sigmar believer who is almost paranoid. He firmly believes that his father was killed in an assassination plot by the Ulric cultists, so he has squeezed all government positions to be exclusive to the Sigmar faction. His worldview was thoroughly shaped by his chief advisor, the Reverend Helgare Bardeen: a hard-line Sigmar priest with deeply traditional views who whispered long sermons into the young Earl's ears about purifying Stirland, expelling the Ulric community, and scorning halflings. Alberich is easily angered, and his ability to govern Stirland should never be questioned in person - he will immediately launch into a long denunciation with a red face. From the undead of Sylvania to the betrayal of Mutt territory, every sentence is an accusation of the injustice done to him by the world. But he was no cold-blooded tyrant: in this province soaked in hunger and fear, he sincerely tried to alleviate the hardships of the farmers. He used his own money to buy grain in winter and distribute it to the frozen border villages. The only thing he dared not do was trust anyone. He was more silent than speaking in the Imperial Diet, calculating the pros and cons on expensive parchment before each vote. His greatest weakness is his predictability - anyone aware of his reliance on Reverend Badin and his hatred of Ulric can easily deduce his next political stance, and this was brilliantly exploited by Karl Franz during the 2502 elections.
Background: Alberich was born into the Haupt-Andersen family, whose rule can be traced back to the era when the Stirland was rebuilt after the Vampire Wars. His father, the old Count Berthold, was a gentle but timid ruler who managed to keep the poor and weak province afloat in the ruins of the Vampire Wars. Alberich spent his boyhood in the castle of Ultbad. The rune-tooth sword rubbings of successive counts were hung on the stone walls of the castle. Before going to bed every night, he could hear the vigil soldiers on the tower singing hymns to ward off the undead. In the late winter when he was fifteen years old, his father was found dead in his study. His face was purple, his mouth and nose were bloodless, and the court physician could not explain the cause of death. Pastor Badin rushed to the Earl's bedroom that night, knelt in front of the boy and announced that the Ulric cultists had infiltrated the Stiir territory to the point of killing the Lord. Alberich never forgot the candlelight of that night, Bardeen's eyes, or his mother's suppressed cries in the next room. After taking the throne, he quickly consolidated power, but in a blunt way - he dismissed all non-Sigmar officials, moved the Ulric nobles to the border areas, and replaced them in the court with exclusively Sigmar priests. His marriage was the product of a political snub: he married a daughter of a minor noble from Reikland, who had little interest in living in the shadow of Sylvania and lived mostly in Altdorf on health grounds. In the Imperial elections of 2502 Alberich initially voted for Lys Todbringer of Middenland - he was fully aware of the irony behind this - but Karl Franz won his vote with a seemingly favorable taxation plan for the Stir River, and what Alberich did not know was that the emperor had already made a completely different deal with the halfling elders of Mut for rights of way to the same river. His first political concern is always the survival of Stirland, secondly the security of Sylvania's borders, and honor and ambition always come third in the province.
